chain.label: FAA failed to monitor Fine Air's cargo operational control and correct known deficiencies
chain.trigger: the failure of the FAA to adequately monitor Fine Air's operational control responsibilities for cargo loading and the failure of the FAA to ensure that known cargo-related deficiencies were corrected at Fine Air

chain.label: Fine Air failed to exercise operational control over the cargo loading process
chain.trigger: the failure of Fine Air to exercise operational control over the cargo loading process

chain.label: Aeromar loading crew ad hoc rearranged pallets aft and left most pallet locks unengaged
chain.trigger: pallets from position 5 aft were pushed back one position each...Pallet 4 was turned 90° and pushed back; 57 of the 60 recovered locks were found in the unlocked position

caused_by.evidence: Fine Air failed to exercise adequate operational control of loading operations conducted by Aeromar on the accident flight

chain.label: Airplane misloaded with CG near or aft of the aft limit (~32.8% MAC), including 1,000 lb of cargo not removed as directed
chain.trigger: the CG of the accident airplane was near or even aft of the airplane's aft CG limit

caused_by.evidence: pushing the 13 pallets aft shifted the CG farther aft by at least 8 percent MAC

chain.label: Stabilizer trim mis-set at 2.4 units ANU relative to the actual aft CG
chain.trigger: the CG shift resulted in the airplane's trim being mis-set by at least 1.5 units ANU

caused_by.evidence: the airplane being misloaded to produce a more aft center of gravity and a correspondingly incorrect stabilizer trim setting

chain.label: Extreme nose-up pitch-up and aerodynamic stall at rotation
chain.trigger: the airplane reached an extremely nose-high pitch attitude in the range of 30° and an AOA approaching 20°, which resulted in an aerodynamic stall

caused_by.evidence: a correspondingly incorrect stabilizer trim setting that precipitated an extreme pitch-up at rotation

chain.label: Delayed and limited crew nose-down column and trim inputs during the recovery attempt
chain.trigger: about a 5-second delay occurred between the flightcrew's first attempt to control the pitch up with nose-down column inputs and the first inputs of nose-down trim

caused_by.evidence: the first officer's continued aft column input for 2 seconds after the captain began his 'easy, easy, easy, easy' remark exacerbated the pitch up that was developing from the mistrimmed stabilizer

chain.label: Airplane briefly recovered then re-entered a stall with recovery unlikely at low altitude
chain.trigger: it recovered briefly from the stall, that it stalled again, and that recovery before ground impact was unlikely once the stall series began

caused_by.evidence: once the initial stall was reached, full recovery was unlikely because of the airplane's low altitude and the airplane's rapidly decreasing performance
the first officer had chosen to trim the airplane in the first, critical moments...he might have been able to correct most, or all, of the mistrim condition, preventing the airplane from stalling

chain.label: Uncontrolled impact with terrain
chain.trigger: the airplane crashed at 1236:25.4...UNCONTROLLED IMPACT WITH TERRAIN

caused_by.evidence: recovery before ground impact was unlikely once the stall series began

chain.label: Fatalities among flightcrew, security guard, and a motorist on the ground
chain.trigger: The three flightcrew members and one security guard on board were killed, and a motorist was killed on the ground

caused_by.evidence: The airplane was destroyed by impact and a postcrash fire
